title: Any OpenAI-compatible API (LLM)
description: Any API that speaks OpenAI's chat completions, as an LLM tier: give its address and key.
setup_notes: Use the address its documentation gives for OpenAI-compatible clients (it ends in /v1 for most). A server on this machine or network with no key is set up directly under Admin > LLMs as llama.cpp or vLLM instead. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which makes one short real chat. Then pick it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM) as Service: <name>: the tier's turns run on it through gohort's own OpenAI-style client, streaming and tool calls as usual, and the key stays in the credential. Its calls and their cost show on the connector's row; add per_million_input and per_million_output to its spec's cost to price its tokens, which then replace the tier's rates under Costs.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: API address
questions.help: The address the API's /chat/completions and /models are under, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1.

questions.name: api_key
questions.label: API key
questions.help: Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector or the LLM settings.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.

questions.name: model
questions.label: Model
questions.help: The model a tier on it runs unless the tier names another.
